title: platynema parvifolium

The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Platynema parvifolium include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
